text:
marina: ACME disputed INV-2024-0042 — large Dedicated overage in us-west2 from weekend DR test (2024-04-02 to 2024-04-03). Overage line $12,120 on top of $16,312 commit. They want a waiver; CS escalated. Dropping in to triage and decide on credit.
invoicer-bot: Invoice INV-2024-0042 generated for ACME Corp — total $28,432 (overage $12,120). Payment due in 30 days.
devin-bill: ACME says their DR failover should have hit reserved failover pool but billed as on-demand. They ran a scheduled test and are pushing for full waiver. @sree can you confirm routing?
sree: Quick allocation audit shows many allocations lacked nodepool label at the time of failover. Metering attributes pool by node label during allocation. Example log: "ALLOCATE pod=acme-dr labels={region:us-west2,nodepool:unlabeled} -> ROUTE pool=on-demand". Looks like an infra/deploy tagging regression.
sree: We can add a CI admission check and runtime guard to enforce nodepool labels within 48hrs. Retroactive reattribution requires a manual billing adjustment and usage report.
carmen-cs: ACME is a long-term committed partner. They'll accept a compromise if we pair a credit with a written fix plan and timeline for the tagging guardrail. They're nervous about repeat events.
oliver-legal: Reminder: our T&Cs cover SLA breaches, and we should avoid admitting liability. If Finance issues a goodwill credit, include a release clause that the customer accepts the credit as full settlement and no admission of fault. Marina — capture invoice/alloc IDs for the memo.
marina: Finance proposes a one-time goodwill credit equal to 50% of the overage ($6,060) plus waiving burst charges for 2 months up to $3k/month as a gesture (max concession ~ $12k). This limits precedent while retaining the customer. Approve?
devin-bill: ACME told CS they'd accept that if we provide the settlement and commit to tagging fixes.
sree: I'll file INFRA-4821 (Tag enforcement + CI gate) and add an alert for unlabeled allocations. We can produce an attribution report for the disputed window to help Billing with the manual adjustment.
oliver-legal: Fine, legal OKs the goodwill credit + waiver offer with release language. I'll draft the settlement doc; CS to collect signature.
ben: Approved. Finance to queue credit memo pending signed settlement. Eng to confirm fix completion. Keep me posted.
carmen-cs: I'll send the settlement template to ACME and request sign-off today. Will post back with the signed document.
marina: Thanks all. Leaving thread open until CS posts signed settlement and Finance posts the credit memo.
